card.name: Science news footer: Materials may be edited
card.fires_on: The words "may" or "be" in the stock footer "Note: Materials may be edited for content and length" after science news stories. Also weakly on "aware" in "be aware that".

card.writes: It slightly suppresses side-effect and harm words, which suggests no real effect on the output here.
card.plain: It fires on the fixed line at the end of science press stories saying the materials may be edited for length.
